title: ⭐️ 01 Assistiti e componenti famiglia - Codice Fiscale
description: Nome, cognome e codice fiscale dell'assistito e dei componenti famiglia, per assistiti attivi e non attivi.
query:
-- ① ASSISTITO (capofamiglia)
SELECT
    c.id                        AS id,
    c.cod                       AS cod,
    CAST(c.number AS UNSIGNED)  AS number,
    c.active                    AS active,
    c.surname                   AS cognome,
    c.name                      AS nome,
    JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`, '$.mod_jobs_anagrafica_cf')) AS codice_fiscale,
    'Assistito'                 AS tipo

FROM customers c
INNER JOIN customers_mod_jobs j ON j.customer_id = c.id

UNION ALL

-- ② COMPONENTI FAMIGLIA
SELECT
    c.id                        AS id,
    c.cod                       AS cod,
    CAST(c.number AS UNSIGNED)  AS number,
    c.active                    AS active,
    JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`,
        CONCAT('$.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp', IF(n.n = 0, '', CONCAT('_', n.n)), '.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp_cognome')
    )) AS cognome,
    JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`,
        CONCAT('$.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp', IF(n.n = 0, '', CONCAT('_', n.n)), '.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp_nome')
    )) AS nome,
    JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`,
        CONCAT('$.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp', IF(n.n = 0, '', CONCAT('_', n.n)), '.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp_cf')
    )) AS codice_fiscale,
    'Componente'                AS tipo

FROM customers c
INNER JOIN customers_mod_jobs j ON j.customer_id = c.id
JOIN (
    SELECT  0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT  1 UNION ALL SELECT  2 UNION ALL
    SELECT  3 UNION ALL SELECT  4 UNION ALL SELECT  5 UNION ALL
    SELECT  6 UNION ALL SELECT  7 UNION ALL SELECT  8 UNION ALL
    SELECT  9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL
    SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14
) n ON JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`,
        CONCAT('$.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp', IF(n.n = 0, '', CONCAT('_', n.n)), '.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp_cf')
       ) IS NOT NULL
   AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`,
        CONCAT('$.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp', IF(n.n = 0, '', CONCAT('_', n.n)), '.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp_cf')
       )) != ''

ORDER BY number ASC, tipo ASC, cognome ASC

title: ⭐️ 02 Compimento 14 anni
description: Assistiti e componenti famiglia che compiono 14 anni nell'anno corrente (già compiuti o in attesa), per organizzare la firma della privacy.
query:
-- ① ASSISTITO (capofamiglia) che compie 14 anni nell'anno corrente
SELECT
    c.id                        AS id,
    c.cod                       AS cod,
    CAST(c.number AS UNSIGNED)  AS number,
    c.active                    AS active,
    c.surname                   AS cognome,
    c.name                      AS nome,
    JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`, '$.mod_jobs_anagrafica_birthday_data')) AS data_nascita,
    DATE_ADD(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`, '$.mod_jobs_anagrafica_birthday_data')), INTERVAL 14 YEAR) AS compimento_data,
    CASE
        WHEN DATE_ADD(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`, '$.mod_jobs_anagrafica_birthday_data')), INTERVAL 14 YEAR) <= CURDATE() THEN 'Compiuto'
        ELSE 'In attesa'
    END AS stato,
    ABS(DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`, '$.mod_jobs_anagrafica_birthday_data')), INTERVAL 14 YEAR), CURDATE())) AS giorni,
    'Assistito'                 AS tipo

FROM customers c
INNER JOIN customers_mod_jobs j ON j.customer_id = c.id
WHERE JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`, '$.mod_jobs_anagrafica_birthday_data') IS NOT NULL
  AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`, '$.mod_jobs_anagrafica_birthday_data')) != ''
  AND YEAR(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`, '$.mod_jobs_anagrafica_birthday_data'))) = YEAR(CURDATE()) - 14

UNION ALL

-- ② COMPONENTI FAMIGLIA che compiono 14 anni nell'anno corrente
SELECT
    c.id                        AS id,
    c.cod                       AS cod,
    CAST(c.number AS UNSIGNED)  AS number,
    c.active                    AS active,
    JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`,
        CONCAT('$.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp', IF(n.n = 0, '', CONCAT('_', n.n)), '.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp_cognome')
    )) AS cognome,
    JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`,
        CONCAT('$.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp', IF(n.n = 0, '', CONCAT('_', n.n)), '.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp_nome')
    )) AS nome,
    JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`,
        CONCAT('$.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp', IF(n.n = 0, '', CONCAT('_', n.n)), '.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp_birthday_data')
    )) AS data_nascita,
    DATE_ADD(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`,
        CONCAT('$.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp', IF(n.n = 0, '', CONCAT('_', n.n)), '.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp_birthday_data')
    )), INTERVAL 14 YEAR) AS compimento_data,
    CASE
        WHEN DATE_ADD(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`,
            CONCAT('$.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp', IF(n.n = 0, '', CONCAT('_', n.n)), '.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp_birthday_data')
        )), INTERVAL 14 YEAR) <= CURDATE() THEN 'Compiuto'
        ELSE 'In attesa'
    END AS stato,
    ABS(DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`,
        CONCAT('$.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp', IF(n.n = 0, '', CONCAT('_', n.n)), '.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp_birthday_data')
    )), INTERVAL 14 YEAR), CURDATE())) AS giorni,
    'Componente'                AS tipo

FROM customers c
INNER JOIN customers_mod_jobs j ON j.customer_id = c.id
JOIN (
    SELECT  0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT  1 UNION ALL SELECT  2 UNION ALL
    SELECT  3 UNION ALL SELECT  4 UNION ALL SELECT  5 UNION ALL
    SELECT  6 UNION ALL SELECT  7 UNION ALL SELECT  8 UNION ALL
    SELECT  9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL
    SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14
) n ON JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`,
        CONCAT('$.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp', IF(n.n = 0, '', CONCAT('_', n.n)), '.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp_birthday_data')
       ) IS NOT NULL
   AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`,
        CONCAT('$.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp', IF(n.n = 0, '', CONCAT('_', n.n)), '.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp_birthday_data')
       )) != ''
WHERE YEAR(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`,
        CONCAT('$.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp', IF(n.n = 0, '', CONCAT('_', n.n)), '.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp_birthday_data')
      ))) = YEAR(CURDATE()) - 14

ORDER BY compimento_data ASC, tipo ASC, cognome ASC

title: ⭐️ 04 Assistiti attivi - Ultima spesa
description: Assistiti attivi con data dell'ultimo ordine, per individuare chi non fa la spesa da tempo.
query:
SELECT
    c.id                        AS id,
    c.cod                       AS cod,
    CAST(c.number AS UNSIGNED)  AS number,
    c.surname                   AS cognome,
    c.name                      AS nome,
    MAX(o.date)                 AS ultima_spesa,
    DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), MAX(o.date)) AS giorni

FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE c.active = 1
GROUP BY c.id, c.cod, c.number, c.surname, c.name
ORDER BY ultima_spesa ASC

title: ⭐️ 08 Elenco assistiti per comune
description: Mostra il conteggio degli assistiti raggruppati per comune di presa in carico (o di residenza se non presente).
query:
SELECT
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`, '$.mod_jobs_anagrafica_comune_presa_in_carico')), ''),
        JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`, '$.mod_jobs_anagrafica_domicilio_comune'))
    ) AS comune,
    COUNT(*) AS totale_assistiti

FROM customers c
INNER JOIN customers_mod_jobs j ON j.customer_id = c.id

GROUP BY comune
ORDER BY comune

title: ⭐️ Assistiti per comune
description: Elenco degli assistiti del comune selezionato nel report Elenco assistiti per comune (comune di presa in carico o di residenza).
query:
SELECT
    c.id                        AS id,
    c.cod                       AS cod,
    CAST(c.number AS UNSIGNED)  AS number,
    c.surname                   AS cognome,
    c.name                      AS nome,
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`, '$.mod_jobs_anagrafica_comune_presa_in_carico')), ''),
        JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`, '$.mod_jobs_anagrafica_domicilio_comune'))
    ) AS comune

FROM customers c
INNER JOIN customers_mod_jobs j ON j.customer_id = c.id

ORDER BY cognome ASC, nome ASC

title: ⭐️ 09 Spesa totale famiglia
description: Mostra, per ogni assistito con almeno un ordine nel periodo selezionato (attivi e non attivi), il numero di componenti famiglia, il comune, le date di inizio/fine periodo e il totale speso in punti.
query:
SELECT
    c.id                          AS id,
    CAST(c.number AS UNSIGNED)    AS number,
    c.surname                     AS cognome,
    c.name                        AS nome,
    c.family_number                AS componenti_famiglia,
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`, '$.mod_jobs_anagrafica_comune_presa_in_carico')), ''),
        JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`, '$.mod_jobs_anagrafica_domicilio_comune'))
    )                              AS comune,
    MIN(o.date)                   AS data_inizio,
    MAX(o.date)                   AS data_fine,
    REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(FORMAT(SUM(o.points), 2), ',', '|'), '.', ','), '|', '.') AS totale_spesa

FROM customers c
INNER JOIN customers_mod_jobs j ON j.customer_id = c.id
INNER JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id

WHERE DATE(o.date) >= COALESCE(?, DATE(o.date))
  AND DATE(o.date) <= COALESCE(?, DATE(o.date))

GROUP BY c.id, c.number, c.surname, c.name, c.family_number, comune
ORDER BY cognome ASC, nome ASC

title: ⭐️ 07 Data ultimo colloquio - Note personali
description: Mostra, per ogni assistito attivo, la data dell'ultimo colloquio registrato con operatore e note (sezione Note Personali), inclusi gli assistiti senza colloqui registrati.
query:
SELECT
    c.id AS id,
    c.cod AS cod,
    c.number AS numero,
    c.surname AS cognome,
    c.name AS nome,
    latest.data_colloquio AS data_colloquio,
    latest.operatore AS operatore,
    latest.note AS note

FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT customer_id, data_colloquio, operatore, note
    FROM (
        SELECT
            j.customer_id,
            JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`, CONCAT('$.mod_jobs_altri_note_personali', IF(n.n = 0, '', CONCAT('_', n.n)), '.mod_jobs_note_personali_data'))) AS data_colloquio,
            JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`, CONCAT('$.mod_jobs_altri_note_personali', IF(n.n = 0, '', CONCAT('_', n.n)), '.mod_jobs_altri_note_personali_operatore'))) AS operatore,
            JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`, CONCAT('$.mod_jobs_altri_note_personali', IF(n.n = 0, '', CONCAT('_', n.n)), '.mod_jobs_altri_note_personali_note'))) AS note,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY j.customer_id
                ORDER BY JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`, CONCAT('$.mod_jobs_altri_note_personali', IF(n.n = 0, '', CONCAT('_', n.n)), '.mod_jobs_note_personali_data'))) DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM customers_mod_jobs j
        JOIN (
            SELECT 0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL
            SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL
            SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14
        ) n ON JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`, CONCAT('$.mod_jobs_altri_note_personali', IF(n.n = 0, '', CONCAT('_', n.n)), '.mod_jobs_note_personali_data')) IS NOT NULL
           AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`, CONCAT('$.mod_jobs_altri_note_personali', IF(n.n = 0, '', CONCAT('_', n.n)), '.mod_jobs_note_personali_data'))) != ''
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
) latest ON latest.customer_id = c.id

WHERE c.active = 1

ORDER BY latest.data_colloquio DESC
